projects.name: auryn-typescript
projects.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript language plugin for Auryn: one fast tree-sitter engine over the whole JS/TS family (.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs), extracting classes/interfaces/enums/type-aliases/functions/methods/params, the ES-module import graph, and calls. A deep tsserver/TS-compiler pass (resolved types, cross-module calls) is the planned second phase.

projects.name: falkordb-auryn
projects.summary: Extracts structural metadata from source code (and SQL databases) into a FalkorDB knowledge graph for AI agent consumption. Umbrella package; language support ships as auryn-<lang> plugins.

projects.name: auryn-terraform
projects.summary: Terraform/OpenTofu plugin for Auryn and the cloud-topology producer of the deployment & infrastructure tier (ADR 0007). Parses HCL (.tf) into Resource nodes (resource/module/data) and DEPENDS_ON edges from interpolation refs, plus the seams: a container image RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, rds -> Database, aws_ecr_repository -> Registry (PROVISIONS). A deploy-terraform enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core + python-hcl2.

projects.name: auryn-swift
projects.summary: Swift language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-swift engine extracting classes/structs/enums/protocols/functions/methods/initializers/properties/params/cases, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS from superclass + protocol conformance, including via extensions), imports, and calls. A deep pass (SourceKit-LSP symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

projects.name: auryn-sql
projects.summary: Generic relational-database schema ingestor for Auryn: reflects any SQLAlchemy-supported engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Oracle, ...) into Database/Schema/Table/Column/View/Sequence/Index/Constraint nodes plus foreign-key edges, via SQLAlchemy's dialect-agnostic Inspector. Dialect-specific DBAPI drivers are optional extras, auto-installed on demand.

projects.name: auryn-rust
projects.summary: Rust language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-rust engine extracting modules/structs/enums/traits/functions/methods/fields/variants/params/consts, the trait hierarchy (IMPLEMENTS/EXTENDS), and calls. An optional deep pass resolves calls precisely via rust-analyzer's SCIP index (trait dispatch, generics, cross-module/crate), degrading to the fast pass when unavailable.

projects.name: auryn-ruby
projects.summary: Ruby language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-ruby engine extracting modules/classes/methods/functions/parameters/fields/constants, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS/INCLUDES), require graph (IMPORTS), and calls. A deep pass (a real Ruby loader / Sorbet / RBS symbol resolver for method dispatch and receiver types) is the planned second phase -- Ruby is dynamic, so the fast pass is name-based only.

projects.name: auryn-python
projects.summary: Python language plugin for Auryn: fast `ast` + deep Jedi (in-process) engines, plus the web-framework route enrichment.

projects.name: auryn-php
projects.summary: PHP language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-php engine extracting namespaces/classes/interfaces/traits/enums/functions/methods/properties/constants/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS/USES_TRAIT), and calls. A deep pass (full name-resolution: use-statement aliasing, autoloading, inherited-member calls) is the planned second phase.

projects.name: auryn-orm
projects.summary: Language-agnostic ORM model<->database-table stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that joins a SQLAlchemy model class (in a code graph) to the physical Table/Column nodes a SQL ingestor produced (in a schema graph), by table/column name. Forms the code->database connection across two ingestors so a query can trace a function -> its ORM model -> the real table. Depends only on auryn-core.

projects.name: auryn-oracle
projects.summary: Oracle-stack plugins for Auryn: live-DB and file-based PL/SQL (vendored ANTLR grammar) and Redgate schema-catalog reconstruction (oraschema). (The generic relational-DB schema ingestor now lives in auryn-sql.)

projects.name: auryn-kustomize
projects.summary: Kustomize plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Render-free: parses kustomization.yaml into a Resource (overlay/base) that RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each ref its images: transformer sets (newName/newTag/digest), and DEPENDS_ON the base kustomizations it layers on (resources/bases/components). A deploy-kustomize enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s/terraform/helm onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

projects.name: auryn-k8s
projects.summary: Kubernetes-manifest plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses k8s manifests into Service (workload) nodes that RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, and Ingress route nodes. A `deploy-k8s` enrichment keys each Ingress route to the HTTP seam's route-keyed APIEndpoint: the Ingress ROUTES to it and the backing workload SERVES it, so an external URL reaches its handler. Composes with auryn-docker/auryn-compose onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

projects.name: auryn-kotlin
projects.summary: Kotlin language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-kotlin engine extracting packages/classes/objects/interfaces/enums/methods/functions/fields/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS), and calls. A deep pass (Kotlin compiler / kotlin-language-server symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

projects.name: auryn-julia
projects.summary: Julia language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-julia engine extracting modules/structs/abstract+primitive types/generic functions/methods/fields/params, the subtype hierarchy (EXTENDS), multiple-dispatch (DISPATCHES_ON), and calls. A deep pass (Julia's own type inference for precise method resolution) is the planned second phase.

projects.name: auryn-http
projects.summary: Language-agnostic HTTP call<->endpoint stitch for Auryn (ADR 0006): a post-ingestion hook that resolves route-keyed APIEndpoint placeholders (emitted by any caller language) to their handler Methods across the shared multi-repo graph, by route and HTTP verb (MVC `/Controller/Action` routes match by name only). Order-independent, 1-to-many, provenance-scoped. Depends only on auryn-core.

projects.name: auryn-java
projects.summary: Java language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-java engine extracting packages/classes/interfaces/enums/records/methods/fields/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS), and calls. A deep pass (Eclipse JDT / javac symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

projects.name: auryn-helm
projects.summary: Helm-chart plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Render-free static parse: Chart.yaml + values.yaml become a Resource (the chart/release) that DEPENDS_ON its chart dependencies (in-repo chart else a placeholder), RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each values.yaml image, and MOUNTS the chart's notable ConfigValues. A deploy-helm enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s/terraform onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

projects.name: blueprint-mcp
projects.summary: Sitemule Blueprint MCP Server - Access IBM i program analysis via MCP

projects.name: auryn-grpc
projects.summary: Language-agnostic gRPC/Protobuf contract stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that parses .proto service contracts and links a client's RPC call and a server's handler Method to the shared contract across languages (caller -CALLS_RPC-> RpcMethod <-IMPLEMENTS_RPC- handler). The RPC analog of the HTTP call<->endpoint seam; ties microservices written in different languages. Depends only on auryn-core.

projects.name: auryn-go
projects.summary: Go language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-go engine extracting packages/structs/interfaces/functions/methods/fields/params/consts, Go embedding (EMBEDS), and calls. IMPLEMENTS (structural interface satisfaction) and precise cross-file type resolution are the planned deep pass (a go/types or gopls-backed engine).

projects.name: auryn-events
projects.summary: Language-agnostic message/event-bus stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that ties a publisher to a subscriber through the topic/queue they share (publisher -PUBLISHES_TO-> Topic <-SUBSCRIBES_TO- subscriber) across Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS/Redis-style brokers -- a decoupled connection that has no call edge in the graph. Depends only on auryn-core.

projects.name: auryn-docker
projects.summary: Dockerfile plugin for Auryn and the first producer of the deployment & infrastructure tier (ADR 0007). A dependency-free Dockerfile parser emits BuildStage nodes, the shared image-keyed `Image` hub (the FROM chain, as resolved:false placeholders) and multi-stage COPY --from edges; a `deploy` enrichment links build stages to the code they package (PACKAGES), recomputes image `resolved` and GCs orphan images. Compose/k8s/Helm/Terraform producers join onto the hub. Depends only on auryn-core.

projects.name: auryn-cuda
projects.summary: CUDA language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cuda engine. CUDA is a superset of C++, so it reuses the auryn-cpp extraction engine verbatim (namespaces/classes/structs/enums/methods/fields/params, type hierarchy, templates, includes/macros, calls) and adds the CUDA-only graph signals: an `execution_space` property (`__global__`/`__device__`/`__host__`) and a LAUNCHES edge for `kernel<<<...>>>` launches. A deep libclang/nvcc pass is the planned second phase.

projects.name: auryn-csharp
projects.summary: C# language plugin for Auryn: fast tree-sitter parse + deep Roslyn extractor (bundled source, built on demand; requires the .NET SDK).

projects.name: auryn-cpp
projects.summary: C++ language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cpp engine extracting namespaces/classes/structs/unions/enums (incl. `enum class`)/methods/fields/params/free functions, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS, multiple inheritance), templates, #includes/macros, and calls -- including out-of-line `Class::method` definitions resolved back to their class. A deep libclang engine (template instantiation, overload resolution, ADL, precise header linking) is the planned second phase.

projects.name: auryn-compose
projects.summary: Docker Compose plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses docker-compose files into Service nodes (RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, DEPENDS_ON other services). A `deploy-compose` enrichment links each service that has both `build:` and `image:` to the Dockerfile stage it builds (`build.target`, else the final stage) with BUILDS_IMAGE, marking the image resolved/internal; the stages come from auryn-docker, so install both. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

projects.name: auryn-core
projects.summary: Core of Auryn: registry/plugin discovery, git+local sources, the FalkorDB graph layer, the MCP server, the viewer, and the `auryn` CLI. Language support ships as separate `auryn-<lang>` plugins.

projects.name: auryn-ci
projects.summary: CI plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml) into a Resource (the pipeline) that BUILDS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each image its steps build or push (docker/build-push-action tags, docker build -t / docker push). That edge flips a hub image resolved/internal, closing the build->image->run loop the docker producer defers to CI. A deploy-ci enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

projects.name: auryn-c
projects.summary: C language plugin for Auryn: fast tree-sitter-c engine (functions/structs/unions/enums/typedefs/globals/macros/#includes/calls, no build config). A deep libclang engine (resolved types, header<->.c linking, cross-TU calls) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-typescript
no_vcs.summary: TypeScript/JavaScript language plugin for Auryn: one fast tree-sitter engine over the whole JS/TS family (.ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs/.cjs), extracting classes/interfaces/enums/type-aliases/functions/methods/params, the ES-module import graph, and calls. A deep tsserver/TS-compiler pass (resolved types, cross-module calls) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-terraform
no_vcs.summary: Terraform/OpenTofu plugin for Auryn and the cloud-topology producer of the deployment & infrastructure tier (ADR 0007). Parses HCL (.tf) into Resource nodes (resource/module/data) and DEPENDS_ON edges from interpolation refs, plus the seams: a container image RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, rds -> Database, aws_ecr_repository -> Registry (PROVISIONS). A deploy-terraform enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core + python-hcl2.

no_vcs.name: auryn-swift
no_vcs.summary: Swift language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-swift engine extracting classes/structs/enums/protocols/functions/methods/initializers/properties/params/cases, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS from superclass + protocol conformance, including via extensions), imports, and calls. A deep pass (SourceKit-LSP symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-sql
no_vcs.summary: Generic relational-database schema ingestor for Auryn: reflects any SQLAlchemy-supported engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Oracle, ...) into Database/Schema/Table/Column/View/Sequence/Index/Constraint nodes plus foreign-key edges, via SQLAlchemy's dialect-agnostic Inspector. Dialect-specific DBAPI drivers are optional extras, auto-installed on demand.

no_vcs.name: auryn-rust
no_vcs.summary: Rust language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-rust engine extracting modules/structs/enums/traits/functions/methods/fields/variants/params/consts, the trait hierarchy (IMPLEMENTS/EXTENDS), and calls. An optional deep pass resolves calls precisely via rust-analyzer's SCIP index (trait dispatch, generics, cross-module/crate), degrading to the fast pass when unavailable.

no_vcs.name: auryn-ruby
no_vcs.summary: Ruby language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-ruby engine extracting modules/classes/methods/functions/parameters/fields/constants, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS/INCLUDES), require graph (IMPORTS), and calls. A deep pass (a real Ruby loader / Sorbet / RBS symbol resolver for method dispatch and receiver types) is the planned second phase -- Ruby is dynamic, so the fast pass is name-based only.

no_vcs.name: auryn-python
no_vcs.summary: Python language plugin for Auryn: fast `ast` + deep Jedi (in-process) engines, plus the web-framework route enrichment.

no_vcs.name: auryn-php
no_vcs.summary: PHP language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-php engine extracting namespaces/classes/interfaces/traits/enums/functions/methods/properties/constants/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS/USES_TRAIT), and calls. A deep pass (full name-resolution: use-statement aliasing, autoloading, inherited-member calls) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-orm
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic ORM model<->database-table stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that joins a SQLAlchemy model class (in a code graph) to the physical Table/Column nodes a SQL ingestor produced (in a schema graph), by table/column name. Forms the code->database connection across two ingestors so a query can trace a function -> its ORM model -> the real table. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-oracle
no_vcs.summary: Oracle-stack plugins for Auryn: live-DB and file-based PL/SQL (vendored ANTLR grammar) and Redgate schema-catalog reconstruction (oraschema). (The generic relational-DB schema ingestor now lives in auryn-sql.)

no_vcs.name: auryn-kustomize
no_vcs.summary: Kustomize plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Render-free: parses kustomization.yaml into a Resource (overlay/base) that RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each ref its images: transformer sets (newName/newTag/digest), and DEPENDS_ON the base kustomizations it layers on (resources/bases/components). A deploy-kustomize enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s/terraform/helm onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

no_vcs.name: auryn-k8s
no_vcs.summary: Kubernetes-manifest plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses k8s manifests into Service (workload) nodes that RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, and Ingress route nodes. A `deploy-k8s` enrichment keys each Ingress route to the HTTP seam's route-keyed APIEndpoint: the Ingress ROUTES to it and the backing workload SERVES it, so an external URL reaches its handler. Composes with auryn-docker/auryn-compose onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

no_vcs.name: auryn-kotlin
no_vcs.summary: Kotlin language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-kotlin engine extracting packages/classes/objects/interfaces/enums/methods/functions/fields/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS), and calls. A deep pass (Kotlin compiler / kotlin-language-server symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-julia
no_vcs.summary: Julia language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-julia engine extracting modules/structs/abstract+primitive types/generic functions/methods/fields/params, the subtype hierarchy (EXTENDS), multiple-dispatch (DISPATCHES_ON), and calls. A deep pass (Julia's own type inference for precise method resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-http
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic HTTP call<->endpoint stitch for Auryn (ADR 0006): a post-ingestion hook that resolves route-keyed APIEndpoint placeholders (emitted by any caller language) to their handler Methods across the shared multi-repo graph, by route and HTTP verb (MVC `/Controller/Action` routes match by name only). Order-independent, 1-to-many, provenance-scoped. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-java
no_vcs.summary: Java language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-java engine extracting packages/classes/interfaces/enums/records/methods/fields/params, the type hierarchy (EXTENDS/IMPLEMENTS), and calls. A deep pass (Eclipse JDT / javac symbol resolution) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-helm
no_vcs.summary: Helm-chart plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Render-free static parse: Chart.yaml + values.yaml become a Resource (the chart/release) that DEPENDS_ON its chart dependencies (in-repo chart else a placeholder), RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each values.yaml image, and MOUNTS the chart's notable ConfigValues. A deploy-helm enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s/terraform onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

no_vcs.name: auryn-grpc
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic gRPC/Protobuf contract stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that parses .proto service contracts and links a client's RPC call and a server's handler Method to the shared contract across languages (caller -CALLS_RPC-> RpcMethod <-IMPLEMENTS_RPC- handler). The RPC analog of the HTTP call<->endpoint seam; ties microservices written in different languages. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-go
no_vcs.summary: Go language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-go engine extracting packages/structs/interfaces/functions/methods/fields/params/consts, Go embedding (EMBEDS), and calls. IMPLEMENTS (structural interface satisfaction) and precise cross-file type resolution are the planned deep pass (a go/types or gopls-backed engine).

no_vcs.name: auryn-events
no_vcs.summary: Language-agnostic message/event-bus stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that ties a publisher to a subscriber through the topic/queue they share (publisher -PUBLISHES_TO-> Topic <-SUBSCRIBES_TO- subscriber) across Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS/Redis-style brokers -- a decoupled connection that has no call edge in the graph. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-docker
no_vcs.summary: Dockerfile plugin for Auryn and the first producer of the deployment & infrastructure tier (ADR 0007). A dependency-free Dockerfile parser emits BuildStage nodes, the shared image-keyed `Image` hub (the FROM chain, as resolved:false placeholders) and multi-stage COPY --from edges; a `deploy` enrichment links build stages to the code they package (PACKAGES), recomputes image `resolved` and GCs orphan images. Compose/k8s/Helm/Terraform producers join onto the hub. Depends only on auryn-core.

no_vcs.name: auryn-cuda
no_vcs.summary: CUDA language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cuda engine. CUDA is a superset of C++, so it reuses the auryn-cpp extraction engine verbatim (namespaces/classes/structs/enums/methods/fields/params, type hierarchy, templates, includes/macros, calls) and adds the CUDA-only graph signals: an `execution_space` property (`__global__`/`__device__`/`__host__`) and a LAUNCHES edge for `kernel<<<...>>>` launches. A deep libclang/nvcc pass is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-csharp
no_vcs.summary: C# language plugin for Auryn: fast tree-sitter parse + deep Roslyn extractor (bundled source, built on demand; requires the .NET SDK).

no_vcs.name: auryn-cpp
no_vcs.summary: C++ language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-cpp engine extracting namespaces/classes/structs/unions/enums (incl. `enum class`)/methods/fields/params/free functions, the class hierarchy (EXTENDS, multiple inheritance), templates, #includes/macros, and calls -- including out-of-line `Class::method` definitions resolved back to their class. A deep libclang engine (template instantiation, overload resolution, ADL, precise header linking) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-compose
no_vcs.summary: Docker Compose plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses docker-compose files into Service nodes (RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, DEPENDS_ON other services). A `deploy-compose` enrichment links each service that has both `build:` and `image:` to the Dockerfile stage it builds (`build.target`, else the final stage) with BUILDS_IMAGE, marking the image resolved/internal; the stages come from auryn-docker, so install both. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

no_vcs.name: auryn-core
no_vcs.summary: Core of Auryn: registry/plugin discovery, git+local sources, the FalkorDB graph layer, the MCP server, the viewer, and the `auryn` CLI. Language support ships as separate `auryn-<lang>` plugins.

no_vcs.name: auryn-ci
no_vcs.summary: CI plugin for Auryn (deployment & infrastructure tier, ADR 0007). Parses GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml) into a Resource (the pipeline) that BUILDS_IMAGE the shared Image hub for each image its steps build or push (docker/build-push-action tags, docker build -t / docker push). That edge flips a hub image resolved/internal, closing the build->image->run loop the docker producer defers to CI. A deploy-ci enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Depends on auryn-core and PyYAML.

no_vcs.name: auryn-c
no_vcs.summary: C language plugin for Auryn: fast tree-sitter-c engine (functions/structs/unions/enums/typedefs/globals/macros/#includes/calls, no build config). A deep libclang engine (resolved types, header<->.c linking, cross-TU calls) is the planned second phase.

no_vcs.name: auryn-bash
no_vcs.summary: Bash/Shell language plugin for Auryn: a fast tree-sitter-bash engine extracting the functions a script defines, the local-functions and external commands each invokes (CALLS), and `source`/`.` includes (IMPORTS). Bash has no types/classes, so the model is deliberately flat (File -> Function -> calls). A deep pass (a real shell resolver / shellcheck-style analysis) is a possible future second phase.
